name: Destruction
description: An undead black dragon who drinks Chloridon's blood and kills Deadalus.

description_citations.text: "The Dragons of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Deadalus raises four dragons as undead; Destruction drinks Chloridon's blood and kills Deadalus.
timeline.quote: Destruction finally returns to Deadalus and kills him.

citation.text: "The Dragons of Magic", section "The Blood of a Dragon , by Edo van Belkom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: spared him after killing Ruin, Death and Rot
relations.quote: Chloridon easily kills Ruin, Death, and Rot, but spares Destruction
